title: If Only We Had Better Counterfactual Explanations: Five Key Deficits to Rectify in the Evaluation of Counterfactual XAI Techniques
reasoning: The paper mentions fairness, accountability, and ethical issues as part of the motivation for eXplainable AI (XAI). However, its core focus is on proposing a roadmap and benchmarks for the technical and psychological evaluation of counterfactual explanation methods. It does not evaluate or benchmark the ethical or moral aspects of AI systems, and the mention of ethics falls within the scope of general considerations, not a primary research component.
